test.name: Fuzz ipc_frame_decode and ipc_request_decode for 5 minutes each on this Mac

expected: cargo xtask fuzz run runs each IPC fuzz target for 300 seconds with the pinned nightly and cargo-fuzz and finds no crash.
actual: no crash in either target and fuzz/artifacts/ empty; ipc_frame_decode: 4257637 runs in 301 s (14144 exec/s), cov 78, ft 232, corpus 53 inputs, peak RSS 588 MB; ipc_request_decode: 3400828 runs in 301 s (11298 exec/s), cov 3796, ft 10904, corpus 2792 inputs, peak RSS 462 MB
steps: on commit 5fb8abe with a clean tree, install the pinned fuzz toolchain: `rustup toolchain install nightly-2026-10-17 --profile minimal` (rustc 1.101.0-nightly 5d8fec066 2026-10-16) and `cargo install --locked cargo-fuzz --version 0.13.2`

run `cargo xtask fuzz run ipc_frame_decode` and `cargo xtask fuzz run ipc_request_decode` side by side with the default --time 300; xtask checks both pins and fuzz/Cargo.lock, then runs libFuzzer with -max_len=65536 -max_total_time=300 on fuzz/corpus/<target> plus the committed fuzz/seeds/<target> (11 and 20 seeds), built by cargo-fuzz with AddressSanitizer; the runs went from 2026-10-18T05:39:41Z to 05:44:45Z
check that both commands exit 0 with `ran for 300 s without a crash`, that fuzz/artifacts/ holds no input for either target, and read the libFuzzer final stats
keep the full ipc_frame_decode log and the head and tail of the ipc_request_decode log in this record's files folder
